pr.title: Regenerate the Projector conventions block in AGENTS.md at template version 14
pr.head: 7583812abded67306705e26f8c1c4beb12b4dd15

summary: AGENTS.md tells agents how to work in this repository. Its generated Projector section came from an older template; this change refreshes it from version 4 to version 14 so agents use the current implementation and inbox workflows.
Only instructions change. The project layout, runtime code, and documentation under docs/ stay as they were.

groups.title: Keep agent workflows current
groups.kicker: Regenerate the shared conventions and distinguish plugin-dependent rules.
intro: Projector generates this block when you run project init. The reminder to change the upstream template now appears before the rules, where an agent sees it before attempting an edit.

A new Projector skills subsection applies when the plugin is installed. It routes changes through the implementation skill, which hands pull requests to a watch loop that handles findings. The draft-pull-request rule moves into that subsection without changing its wording.

The subsection also explains the inbox: use ask for decisions and tell for news the person must not miss, keep normal conversation alongside it, and withdraw or revise items when replies settle or clarify them.

files.note: The repository’s agent instructions gain the template version 14 workflow and inbox rules.

checks.text: Read the complete diff and confirmed that the draft rule moves unchanged; the documentation and stack rules remain intact.
Ran project check at this head; it prints “Project plans are valid.”
